scope: All 806 records attributed to exactly one collection route. No recipient data were changed by this investigation.
findings: The counts measure surviving merged records and collection routes, not genuinely exclusive people or independent publications.
BPR-only: six role descriptions incorrectly treated as people; nine name variants with counterparts; Tobias Morgenstern remains a plausible genuine exclusive record.
WikiProjekt-only: 37 automatic duplicate/identity flags; additional manually identified title, particle, malformed-link and name-order problems. This is not a validated exclusive-source count.

Bundesanzeiger-only: seven entries appear in the December 2021 announcement but not the collected BPR/WikiProjekt lists. Original gazette HTML confirms plain recipient rows, not deleted text. Hans Abich is present in the January 2019 gazette, but another collected source records a same-name award in 1988; identity/date requires review.

36 apparently exclusive records have exact-name matches in official/mirrored 2015 announcements that were discarded after the 120-day award-date estimate put them in 2014. This flags date reconciliation, not proof that those awards occurred in 2015.
Wikidata-only includes the organisation Jugendnotmail; shared-QID matches include likely incorrect entity links, so a QID-only automatic merge is unsafe.
Press-only includes pages from bundespraesident.de and English Wikipedia; search describes the acquisition method, not the publisher.
All duplicate candidates require source-level adjudication before revised unique-person or exclusive-source totals can be reported.
